name: away-web
description: Away's pages around the sessions: the frame, signing in, the settings.

whatFor.react-dom: puts what React draws into the browser's page
whatFor.@nalet/design-system: the components and the tokens the pages are made of
whatFor.lucide-react: the icons, which the design system's components use as well
whatFor.@fontsource/inter: the font of the pages' text, as files of the build, so that none is fetched from a font service
whatFor.@fontsource/jetbrains-mono: the font of names, labels and code, as files of the build
whatFor.typescript: checks the pages' code before it is built
whatFor.vite: builds the pages into files whose names carry their content's hash
whatFor.@vitejs/plugin-react: lets vite build what is written for React
whatFor.@playwright/test: opens the pages in a real browser and goes through them as a person does, in the pages' tests
whatFor.@axe-core/playwright: checks each page against the rules for accessibility, in the pages' tests
